name: cate.hoppscotch
description: Hoppscotch wrapper, a server-backed Cate extension. Embeds a user-run Hoppscotch instance reverse-proxied through a loopback-bound wrapper with a built-in Proxyscotch-compatible request proxy.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:panel && node ./copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
